sources.title: Control Group v2
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: Linux 記憶體熱移除：可移動頁與釘住區塊
related.titleEn: Linux memory hot-remove: movable pages and pinned blocks
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付限制樹、容量帳本、限制來源與事件分類表，並附時間不同步的拒絕案例；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the hierarchy, budget ledger, limiting-ancestor explanation and classified event table. Include a rejection case for incompatible snapshot times so apparently precise arithmetic cannot conceal inconsistent observations. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 輸入 block_id、page_id、movable 與 pin_owner，產生 blocked_blocks 和可遷移頁清單；不得以釘住頁數直接減容量。
related.differenceEn: Input block_id, page_id, movable and pin_owner fields. Produce blocked-block and migratable-page lists, preserving the difference between the count of pinned pages and the capacity of blocks they obstruct.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 在不可回收且無其他支出的簡化前提下，子群可用預算為 min(子上限,父上限－兄弟用量)；這不是核心下一次配置結果的預測；父上限 12 GiB、子上限 10 GiB；兄弟用量由 5 增為 8 GiB，其他用量固定為零；名義式 min(10,12-5) = 7 GiB；變更式 min(10,12-8) = 4 GiB。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
本課保守模型將含釘住頁的區塊全部視為不可移除，其餘區塊視為可成功遷移；容量為可移除區塊數乘區塊大小；十個各 256 MiB 區塊；名義三個被釘住，變更五個被釘住，區塊大小與總容量固定；名義式 (10-3)*256 = 1792 MiB；變更式 (10-5)*256 = 1280 MiB。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Assuming no reclaimable memory or other charges, available child budget is the smaller of its own limit and parent headroom after sibling usage. This does not predict a kernel allocation’s exact outcome. Parent capacity is 12 GiB and the child limit is 10 GiB. Sibling use changes from 5 to 8 GiB, with zero other charges and no reclaim in this synthetic snapshot. Nominal min(10,12-5) = 7 GiB; changed min(10,12-8) = 4 GiB. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

The conservative fixture marks every block containing a pinned page as nonremovable and assumes all remaining blocks can migrate successfully. Removable capacity is eligible block count times block size. Model ten blocks of 256 MiB. Three blocks initially contain pinned pages, then five do. Block size and total installed memory remain fixed; migration destination capacity is assumed sufficient. Nominal (10-3)*256 = 1792 MiB; changed (10-5)*256 = 1280 MiB. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ECN：標記比例的正確分母與時間窗
related.titleEn: ECN: correct denominators and windows for marking ratios
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付限制樹、容量帳本、限制來源與事件分類表，並附時間不同步的拒絕案例；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。

related.difference: 建立 packet_id、class、window、ecn 欄位；以篩選後集合產生分子分母清單，再與原始總量比對。
related.differenceEn: Build packet_id, class, window and ecn fields. Materialize numerator and denominator memberships after filtering, then reconcile them with raw totals so scope errors remain visible.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 在不可回收且無其他支出的簡化前提下，子群可用預算為 min(子上限,父上限－兄弟用量)；這不是核心下一次配置結果的預測；父上限 12 GiB、子上限 10 GiB；兄弟用量由 5 增為 8 GiB，其他用量固定為零；名義式 min(10,12-5) = 7 GiB；變更式 min(10,12-8) = 4 GiB。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比例為同方向、同 class、同時間窗內 CE 標記封包除以可評估封包數；標記數不是位元組數也不是丟包數；兩組均有 1000 個 CE 標記封包；合格封包總數由 10000 改為 5000，無重置或取樣遺失；名義式 1000/10000*100 = 10 %；變更式 1000/5000*100 = 20 %。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Assuming no reclaimable memory or other charges, available child budget is the smaller of its own limit and parent headroom after sibling usage. This does not predict a kernel allocation’s exact outcome. Parent capacity is 12 GiB and the child limit is 10 GiB. Sibling use changes from 5 to 8 GiB, with zero other charges and no reclaim in this synthetic snapshot. Nominal min(10,12-5) = 7 GiB; changed min(10,12-8) = 4 GiB. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

The ratio divides CE-marked packets by eligible packets from the same direction, class and interval. Mark counts are not byte totals, drop counts or a direct measure of receiver throughput. Both fixtures have 1000 CE-marked packets. Eligible packet totals change from 10000 to 5000, with no counter reset or missing samples and with stable classification. Nominal 1000/10000*100 = 10 %; changed 1000/5000*100 = 20 %. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
